commands.name: StartRfcWfmImportCheck
steps: validate authenticated invocation and source family
inside short UoW perform command idempotency and create one durable LLD-01 job with bounded source-family/profile/manual-selection reference; no workbook bytes
audit check initiation and commit
worker executes discovery/security/parsing outside domain mutation transactions
rules: manual selection may be outside directory but cannot bypass source validation
one source check never scans Communications or mutates RFC/WFM/Task state

commands.name: PublishStagedImportRun
steps: during validating state immutable observation/finding batches may be appended in bounded transactions but remain non-reviewable because run is unpublished
after parser reaches complete EOF, recompute exact child counts and logical fingerprint from persisted immutable staging rows
classify replay/chronology against current source-family checkpoint
if exact replay mark run noop and create no reconciliation proposals
if newer-identical mark run noop and record eligible bounded checkpoint-recency transition without per-entity observation/proposal duplication beyond this run's technical evidence policy
if equal chronology/different content or older chronology mark recovery_required and create no ordinary domain-acceptance authority
otherwise generate all reconciliation proposals, atomically set run staged/waiting_review with exact counters/fingerprint/revision
only staged/waiting_review/recovery_required/noop runs are visible to import-review queries
rules: crash before publish cannot make partial run reviewable
source omission produces no RFC/WFM disappearance proposals

commands.name: AcceptReconciliationProposal
steps: load pending proposal and exact staged source/run/profile evidence
reject blocked/recovery-required/unsafe-auto path
inside one short UoW recompute current authoritative base-state token via owning LLD readers
on mismatch return IMPORT_PROPOSAL_STALE with no accepted disposition/domain mutation
enter one outer idempotent command envelope; the owning domain service receives the same UoW/command context and must not commit independently
invoke the exact LLD-02/03/05 mutation service selected by proposal_kind; terminal RFC source projection therefore uses LLD-03 terminal-epoch/cascade-proposal semantics
append accepted proposal disposition and required audit/result references in the same UoW
transition proposal accepted, refresh run counters, commit
rules: one acceptance never implicitly accepts sibling proposals
source acceptance never executes RFC terminal cascade or Objective regrouping
Beta 1.0 RFC/WFM mutation auto-accept policy is empty

commands.name: RejectReconciliationProposal
steps: revalidate exact pending proposal/fingerprint
insert receipt
append rejected disposition and optional bounded equivalence decision
transition proposal rejected/update run counters
audit decision
commit
rules: rejection does not erase valid source presence
newer chronology alone does not force redisplay when material-input equivalence remains exact

commands.name: DeferReconciliationProposal
steps: revalidate pending proposal
insert receipt
append deferred disposition/equivalence evidence
transition proposal deferred/update run counters
audit
commit
rules: explicit reconsideration may create a fresh proposal bound to current state without rewriting old decision

commands.name: FinalizeImportRunReview
steps: inside UoW require run is ordinary staged/waiting_review and has zero pending proposals
recompute exact proposal/disposition counters and verify no blocked unresolved scope is being hidden
insert receipt
derive final run state accepted when all target proposals accepted/no_change, rejected when all actionable proposals rejected, otherwise partially_accepted including mixes with rejected/deferred
advance/replace source-family checkpoint to this run's chronology/fingerprint only when chronology is newer than current or checkpoint absent; never move backward
record bounded review-finalization audit and commit
rules: checkpoint represents latest explicitly processed source observation set, not proof every proposed domain mutation was accepted
RFC/WFM omission still has no lifecycle meaning
a deferred proposal remains historical decision evidence and may later be reconsidered independently

commands.name: RecordNewerIdenticalSourceCheck
steps: inside UoW revalidate newer chronology and identical logical fingerprint
insert receipt
advance checkpoint chronology/run/last_checked while preserving fingerprint
mark run noop/completed
audit bounded source-check recency
commit
commands.rule: creates no duplicate per-entity source observations, proposals or domain audit changes

commands.name: ResolveImportRecovery
steps: follow algorithms/recovery.json
reject/defer records disposition with no domain mutation/checkpoint change
authorize_correction enables explicit per-proposal reviewed correction path and records immutable recovery event only after consistent completion
equal-chronology accepted correction may replace fingerprint at same chronology; older recovery never decrements checkpoint
commit according to recovery transaction contract

worker_recovery: startup finds durable import jobs/runs left discovering/validating by prior process and classifies them interrupted through LLD-01 job recovery
an unpublished partial run is never resumed as if complete; deterministic restart either resumes from a verified parser checkpoint owned by the durable job or marks it failed and starts a new run

source observations belonging to non-published failed runs never participate in replay/proposal/domain queries and may be removed only by separately governed technical-staging housekeeping, never as operational-history purge
